Title: FitSlice Fit Kit
Body (HTML):
Find your size before you print your fit. The Fit Kit is a sizer plate printed around the hole sizes you expect, in 1/64-inch steps, with a roll of bowler's tape and a fitting card.

  • Printed on the same printer and material as your trainer, so the bore that fits is the bore we print.
  • Size engraved beside each bore. The right bore is snug all around at the first joint with no squeeze needed to hang on.
  • The $24 is credited toward a Rev Puck, Rev Spinner or Pair with the code in the box.

Enter your expected thumb, middle and ring sizes in the fields below, or build your plate in the free configurator and paste the fit sheet. Ships in 3 business days. A fitting tool for use off the lane. Not a bowling ball.

Title: FitSlice Rev Puck
Body (HTML):
Your drill sheet, off the ball. It's the part of your ball your hand touches, printed with your exact holes, so you can practice your release anywhere.

  • Built from your drill sheet: hole sizes in 1/64-inch steps, both spans, forward/reverse and lateral pitch for every hole, right or left hand, through or blind thumb, on the curvature of a regulation 8.5-inch ball.
  • Holes are aimed at the ball's center the way a zero-pitch hole is drilled, so your thumb and fingers oppose each other exactly as on your ball.
  • About 300 g in PETG at 20% infill. Weight pocket for coins or washers. Wrist-cord tunnel and paracord loop for swing drills.
  • Designed to practice a relaxed fingertip hold and a clean, early thumb exit. Four drills on the card. Coaches agree the thumb must leave first and a relaxed hand creates more revs.

Made to order from the fit sheet you enter below. Ships within 5 business days of a complete sheet. 30-day fit guarantee: if the printed holes do not match your sheet, we reprint free. A training aid for use off the lane. Not a bowling ball. Swing-and-hold drills only; never throw it.

Title: FitSlice Rev Spinner
Body (HTML):
Lift it, spin it, count it. The Rev Spinner is a fingers-only release disc printed from your drill sheet: middle and ring hole sizes in 1/64-inch steps, your finger pitches, right or left hand, on the curvature of a regulation 8.5-inch ball.

  • Release it onto carpet from a short pendulum swing and it spins in place. The engraved bars on the base flicker as it spins; count the seconds until it stops. Designed to give you a cue on finger lift through how long it spins. It is a feedback device. It is not a measuring instrument.
  • Two drills on the card: carpet spins and rotation-axis control.
  • About 100 g in PETG. The product for two-handed bowlers and for anyone working on finger lift.

Made to order from the fit sheet you enter below. Ships within 3 business days of a complete sheet. 30-day fit guarantee. A training aid for use off the lane. Not a bowling ball. Carpet-release drills only; never throw it.

Title: FitSlice Digital Files
Body (HTML):
Your fit, as files for your own printer. We generate the STL for your Rev Puck, or for your Rev Puck and Rev Spinner, from the fit sheet you enter, plus a sizer-plate STL centered on your sizes and your fit sheet as a JSON file.

  • Same geometry as the parts we print, built from your drill sheet.
  • Print settings included: PETG or PLA+, 4 walls, 20% gyroid infill, flat side down, no supports.
  • Print the sizer plate first. Printed holes come out 0.2 to 0.4 mm small, and the plate calibrates your printer before you print the big part.

Delivered by email within one business day of a complete fit sheet. If the files do not match your sheet, we regenerate them free. Because we do not control your printer or filament, the fit guarantee on printed dimensions does not apply to digital files. Digital goods are not refundable except where the files are defective. Training aids for use off the lane. Not bowling balls. Never throw them.
